biggest_catch: The $100 only posts after the resident stays a TXU customer in good standing for at least 90 days - if they leave or fall delinquent within 90 days, you earn nothing.
catches: Only landlords referring new residents of their properties qualify; the referrer must be the landlord of record.
The resident must sign up for new TXU service (via the Referral Card) and remain a customer in good standing for at least 90 days.
No reward if the resident cancels, switches, or becomes delinquent within the first 90 days.
Total Satisfaction Guarantee and same-day lights-on benefits apply to the new resident's service, not the landlord's reward.

c3.evidence: Incentive framed as savings on planned energy spending (TXU reward credited to the landlord), never income.

c4.evidence: Distinct supplier mechanism; R0845 covers TXU's residential refer-a-friend, R1876 covers TXU's usage-credit plan - the landlord program is a genuinely different mechanism.

eligibility: Landlords (of record) whose new residents sign up for TXU Energy residential service.
notes: Landlord-targeted referral framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income. Distinct mechanism from TXU's residential referral (R0845) and TXU's usage-credit plan (R1876).

payout_value_note: $100 per new resident who signs up for TXU service and stays a customer in good standing for at least 90 days.

steps: As a landlord, tell your new residents about TXU Energy and share the Referral Card.
Your resident signs up for new TXU service before 6:30 p.m. for same-day lights-on.
After the resident remains in good standing for 90 days, $100 is automatically earned by you.
Repeat for each new resident; each qualifying signup earns $100.
timing: Sharing the referral takes 5-15 minutes of active effort; the $100 reward posts after the resident's 90th day in good standing.
